_comment: Lane RELEASE-1: the known issues a tester meets, for README_TESTERS.txt (tools/release/readme_testers.py). Each item names the docs/STOPS.md rows it comes from; the generator copies their Area and fails when a row is gone (the issue was resolved or renumbered: update this list). Keep the text in a player's words.

issues.text: Only the English versions of the two games are supported; a game in another language is refused on the first start.

Campaign: missions play with their movies and narration, but there is no campaign menu between missions and no saving of your progress the original way; the next mission loads directly. Loading screens do not show the mission picture.
Save / Load and War of the Ring are not available yet. Skirmish, the campaign and LAN games are.

Create-a-Hero: heroes can be built, coloured and saved, but how the house colour blends into the model is an educated guess, and the colour is not reapplied to lower-detail textures the way the original may do.
Team colours on units and buildings are an educated guess at how the original blends them, and may look different.
The computer opponent builds a base, trains armies, attacks and finishes games, but does not yet defend, expand or use heroes the way the original does.
Enemy buildings destroyed out of your sight disappear at once instead of staying in the fog until you look again.
Some sounds are missing: units being damaged, scripted music and parts of the big-battle ambience.
Menus are laid out for 1024x768 and scaled: at other window sizes text and click targets can be slightly off. Widescreen camera framing may differ from the original.
Menus cannot be used with the keyboard or a gamepad, only with the mouse.
Some lists and boxes of a menu show through pop-ups placed over them.
Radar: attacks raise pings, but scripted pings, the Ring and beacon markers, and the "under attack" voice lines are missing.
Every game is recorded as a replay and can be watched from Load Replay, but replays cannot be saved under a name, there are no replay controls, and the score screen's graphs are simplified.
LAN: the disconnect screen has no chat.
